newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randfontein March qtr pre-capex net in loss.
newsitem.headline: Randfontein March qtr pre-capex net in loss.

text.p: Quarter to end-March versus preceding quarter
Net loss before capex 2.86 vs 43.83 profit
Full name: Randfontein Estates Gold Mining Co Ltd Witwatersrand Ltd, managed by JCI Ltd.

NOTE - The company said that all development in marginal areas was being reviewed, as was the supply of other low grade ore sent to the plants. The extended Christmas holiday break negatively affected volume production.
Progress on the South Reef project continues at satisfactory levels but the future profitability is being re-evaluated in the light of the current gold price and the company's available resources.
The mine said it was also reviewing all options to establish optimal, efficient production levels from each area which could result in a further labour retructuring programme.
